Hi Oliver / Anna —

Thanks again for the intro call today — nice to learn more about BrightOptics' annotation workflow and where you want to reduce inference costs and latency for the QC tool. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have shared alignment: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for batch annotation and live QC flows (reduce per-token cost by >30% with similar output quality).
- Success criteria for POC: 1) end-to-end integration with your test dataset, 2) baseline vs Redwood cost comparison, 3) latency under 150ms p95 for live QC route.
- Proposed POC scope: 2-week trial, run on Redwood hosted dedicated test pool, up to 500k tokens total.

Action items / owners:
- Marissa: create trial access and share setup steps (attached).
- BrightOptics: share sample dataset + API access for your test harness by May 28.
- Schedule kickoff: propose Tues June 2 at 10am PT for a 30-min setup session.

I've attached a short POC-checklist and the trial quickstart to this thread (POC-checklist.pdf, redwood-trial-instructions.pdf). If June 2 doesn't work, let me know alternate slots the week of June 8.

If there are internal security/IT items I should loop Rafael in on, say the word and I'll add him. Looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
